key_claims: The document is a CIA information report, not finally evaluated intelligence, dated 5 April 1999, containing a targeting study of the U.S. Embassy in Nairobi.
The study describes the embassy as a six-storey building (underground, ground floor, four upper floors) surrounded by a roughly 3 m steel-bar fence set about 2.5 m back.
Moi Street and Haile Selassie Avenue are described as among the most crowded streets in central Nairobi, easily reached by any transport or on foot.
The main entrance is glass, on Moi Street, with six steps and a nine-metre width; metal poles on the sidewalk edge block vehicles from approaching the embassy.
The available text is heavily excised and contains no named individuals or identified perpetrators.
